_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Cameleon 3 (Cameleon³). Discontinued by Bugaboo; new US retail stock is scarce (open-box / used marketplace only). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Cameleon 3

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo Cameleon³ — Bugaboo Cameleon³ adapter for Maxi-Cosi car seat (80401MC02) — *5 handle positions; Liing usable in positions 3–5

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo lists 9.6 kg (21.1 lb) for the Cameleon 3 (chassis + seat).
specs._unfoldedNote: Bugaboo publishes 94 x 59 x 101-112 cm (L x W x H); height varies with the telescopic handlebar (39.8-44.1 in). Max-handlebar height (112 cm / 44.1 in) recorded here.
specs._foldedNote: Bugaboo publishes folded 90 x 50 x 31 cm (35.4 x 19.7 x 12.2 in); folds as a two-piece (seat/bassinet detached from chassis).
specs._brakeNote: Strollberry lists the Cameleon 3 brake as a hand-operated central brake; recorded as central parking brake (sourced, not manufacturer-numbered).

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (included bassinet/carrycot; seat has full lie-flat recline)

safety.standards: Bugaboo declares conformity to the US juvenile stroller standard ASTM F833; Clek states strollers on its list were tested and are compliant with the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness. No JPMA certification is published for this Bugaboo model; certifications left null rather than guessed. Max child weight 17 kg (~37.5 lb) per Bugaboo.

specs.foldType: two-piece fold (seat/bassinet detaches from chassis), self-standing
specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest incl. full lie-flat (3 positions); reversible seat + included bassinet
specs.tires: 6 in (15 cm) swivel foam front wheels; 12 in (30 cm) foam-filled (puncture-free) rear wheels; adjustable suspension

notes: Full-size convertible city/all-terrain Bugaboo. Clek-listed via the Bugaboo Cameleon³ Maxi-Cosi adapter 80401MC02 (adapter-80401mc02), which explicitly lists the Clek Liing. HANDLE-POSITION CAVEAT (carried from Clek's list): the Cameleon³ handlebar has 5 positions and the Clek Liing is usable only in positions 3-5. STOCK: Bugaboo has DISCONTINUED the Cameleon 3 (its US product page is marked 'no longer available') and it is not carried new by the US Shopify retailers checked - only open-box/used (GoodBuy Gear $101.99, out of stock) and used-marketplace listings (eBay, ~$480 for near-new) are available as of 2026-07-05, so prices are condition-dependent and volatile. Heavier and larger-folding than the Bee 6; less ideal for the compact city/shopping goal but a capable lie-flat, bassinet-included convertible.
